max_fee_cap.meaning: DynamicSwapFeeModule.MAX_FEE_CAP, the module's internal maximum fee cap, reported as 500,000 (50%)

dynamic_fee_applied.meaning: the dynamically calculated fee from DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() is applied by CLFactory.getSwapFee() rather than replaced by the basic tick spacing fee

falls_back_to_basic_tick_spacing_fees.meaning: the system always falls back to basic tick spacing fees instead of applying the dynamically calculated fee

assumptions: The dynamic fee mechanism is expected to apply dynamically calculated fees when the module permits fees up to its configured cap.

unresolved.description: The intent states the dynamic fee mechanism should remain effective rather than always falling back to basic tick spacing fees, but the report does not state a distinct applicability condition or a separate required observable beyond the desired outcome itself; the condition and effect both rest on the same dynamic-fee-applied observable.

limitations: The frozen P fact (MAX_FEE_CAP = 500,000) is a configuration value and does not by itself scope the intent's applicability condition.
The report's mechanism (CLFactory rejecting fees above 100,000) is relation-context evidence only and is not encoded as a P or I condition.

links.reported_relation: The module permits fees up to 500,000 (50%) while CLFactory.getSwapFee() rejects any fee above 100,000 (10%), so the system always falls back to basic tick spacing fees, rendering the dynamic fee mechanism ineffective.
Any dynamically calculated fee above 10% is rejected by the factory, so dynamically calculated fees are not applied and the 50% anti-MEV cap becomes unusable.
